Hi Maya —

Thanks for the context and the usage file. Short answers up front: yes, we can do a staged uplift with prorated invoicing, and timing affects both discount tiers and invoice alignment (details below).

High-level proposal (attached as an example schedule):
- Staged uplift: +30% immediate top-up (effective on signing) + optional +20% tranche in 90 days. Both tranches billed pro-rata for the remainder of the contract term.
- Discount ladder: 0% uplift = current rate; 20% uplift = 8% discount on added units; 50%+ uplift = 14% discount on new committed units. Discounts apply to committed units only.
- Co-term outcome: we can co-term to 2026-12-31 with an annualized true-up at renewal or offer an annualize-now path (move billing to a Jan–Dec cycle) if Orchid prefers.

Procurement timing impact:
- Sign in July: First tranche effective immediately; you receive an early-commit incentive (1 month waived on new committed units) and we can align invoicing to next monthly invoice.
- Sign in September: Pricing tiers still available but the pro-rata period is shorter — fewer months over which to amortize increases, so the effective monthly charge is higher; limited eligibility for the early-commit incentive.

Next steps I recommend:
1) We draft a one-page amendment showing tranches, prorate math, and the discount ladder.
2) You decide preferred co-term approach (maintain Dec 31 or move to Jan–Dec).
3) If acceptable, Ben will scope billing/invoice changes and Lauren will prepare legal/contract language for a simple amendment.

Sending the example schedule now: proposed_uplift_schedule.xlsx.

Best,
Karthik Iyer

- July path: amortizes the new committed units over 6 months (Jul–Dec). Example effective monthly delta on your P&L: ~$12k for the July tranche at the 30% uplift level (after early-commit incentive).
- September path: amortizes over 4 months (Sep–Dec) — effective monthly delta rises to ~$18k for the same uplift, because there are fewer months to spread the cost.
- Co-term decision: keeping Dec 31 is fine and preserves your FY27 budget planning. If Orchid moves billing Jan–Dec, we can offer a modest additional 2% blended discount (only if you annualize now and commit to 12 months of the elevated commitment).
